rationale: The assistant correctly led with an oven thermometer, a sensible knob check and the neon-cycling question, and handled the messy spelling well. However, after the customer reported no thermometer, it downgraded measurement to 'optional' and moved to 'points pretty strongly at the main oven thermostat' with DIY replacement steps (removing the control panel, threading the capillary), exceeding the user-checks-only boundary and skipping the preheat/shelf-position and door-seal follow-ups that the ground truth flags as live alternatives. It did hedge with model-number requirements and an engineer option, and isolation advice was present, so no critical failure is clearly quotable, but calibration and part justification are premature.
